Here Are the Senators Who Are Backing Van Hollen Over Schumer for Senate Majority Leader

Senator Chris Van Hollen has said that he has the backing of about 15 of his colleagues in his quest to challenge Senator Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader. So far, only a few of them have publicly declared their support.
